author: a. j. zhao
title: Hannah Pitts earns second Big West Pitcher of the Week award
text:
University of Hawai’i softball pitcher Hannah Pitts was named Big West Pitcher of the Week for the second time, according to an April 6 announcement. The award, presented by Rawlings, follows her strong performance against UC Santa Barbara.
Pitts’s achievement highlights her significant contribution to the team’s success in conference play. Her pitching helped secure a victory over UC Santa Barbara, which currently leads the league.
During Game 2 at UCSB, Pitts pitched a complete-game shutout over seven innings and led Hawai’i to a 6-0 win. Over two appearances during the week, she recorded a 0.00 earned run average across 7.1 innings and threw a total of 113 pitches in her start. She allowed no runs and struck out three batters while limiting UCSB hitters to a .267 batting average and no extra-base hits.
With these performances, Pitts improved her season record to eight wins and four losses overall, including five wins and one loss in conference games. In Big West competition, she holds a 1.32 earned run average over more than forty-two innings pitched.
Nationally, Pitts ranks seventh in walks allowed per seven innings with an average of just over one walk per game and is twelfth with four shutouts this season.
The recognition reflects both individual excellence and its impact on team results as conference play continues.
